candidates.title: Here is a GIFT: Enforcing User Data Isolation in LLM Serving via GPU Information Flow Tracking
candidates.reason: Implemented vLLM/DistServe security-system work for shared serving, using per-user encryption and static GPU-kernel information-flow rules with low measured throughput overhead. Adds an under-covered isolation dimension to serving systems.

candidates.title: CoLLM: Continuous Adaptation for SLO-Aware LLM Serving on Shared GPU Clusters
candidates.reason: Co-execution system sharing model parameters and replicas between parameter-efficient fine-tuning and inference, with adaptive two-timescale coordination and real-trace goodput evaluation.
